description: This Java class defines a fragment (PopupListFragment) that displays a list of cheeses, each with a clickable button that shows a popup menu to remove the item. The class manages list item clicks, popup menu interactions, and a custom ArrayAdapter to display the list items with popup buttons.

classes.name: PopupListFragment
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays a list of cheeses with popup menu options per item, allowing removal of items.

classes.name: PopupAdapter
classes.description: An ArrayAdapter subclass that inflates list items with a popup button and sets up button click handling.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Sets up the list with a custom adapter upon activity creation.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles normal list item clicks, showing a toast with the item name.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on the popup button, posting a Runnable to show the popup menu.

methods.name: showPopupMenu
methods.description: Creates and displays a PopupMenu for a given list item view, handling item selection to remove items.

methods.name: PopupAdapter
methods.description: Custom array adapter inflating list items with a popup button, associating each button with its item data.
